name: ctxdiet
description: Audit and fix AI coding-agent context bloat. Proves which MCP servers and skills you never use from local session history, then reclaims the tokens. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Cline, Roo & more. Runs as a CLI or an MCP server.
author: Merlijn de Groot <merlijndegroot498@gmail.com>

scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc && node --test dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.coverage: npm run clean && tsc && node --test --experimental-test-coverage dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.lint:dashes:
node -e "const{execSync}=require('node:child_process');const out=execSync('git ls-files',{encoding:'utf8'}).split('
').filter(Boolean).filter(f=>{try{return require('node:fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8').includes('—')}catch{return false}});if(out.length){console.error('em dash (U+2014) found in:
  '+out.join('
  '));process.exit(1)}console.log('no em dashes')"
